plan.title: Order Activity records Convert to Auction

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow for the RFQ test event.
Provide the required event title so the RFQ can be published and reopened.
Configure the event as an RFQ, which is the source event for conversion.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and pricing sheet.
Apply an RFQ template required for line-item configuration and publishing.
Add the minimum line item needed for the RFQ.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Add the required participant for a usable published event.
Publish the RFQ before attempting conversion.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Perform the conversion action whose activity record is being tested.
Return to the original event page so its project history can be inspected.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Assert that the conversion is recorded in the event history.
